rounds.text: The primary risk for investors in Faalcon Concepts Ltd is a clear and persistent deterioration in capital efficiency. While the company historically maintained a median return on equity of 19% over five years [E19], this metric has collapsed to 14% over three years [E20] and further plummeted to 9% in the most recent year [E21]. This downward trend is corroborated by the current ROE of 6.54%, which now trails the sector benchmark of 7.6% [E8]. Furthermore, the company offers no dividend yield to compensate shareholders for this declining performance [E4]. Conceded: [E1], [E2], [E6], [E7], and [E19]. Investors must weigh the current valuation against the reality that the firm's ability to generate returns on equity is significantly underperforming its historical standards [E19], [E21].
